title: Exact finite ordinary direct image on underlying ind hearts
statement: Fix D,l,Ω and a finite morphism f₀:X₀→Y₀ of finite-type k₀-schemes. Ind extension of the prescribed pullback of the underlying small constructible common-stage hearts has a right adjoint R, and R preserves finite colimits. No category of Frobenius pairs is used. Absolute separatedness of X₀ and Y₀ is not assumed. The conclusion includes the underlying ordinary inverse-image adjunction, before any Weil structure is added.

source.place: Clause (1), exact finite direct image; Stacks 09A8 and Bhatt--Scholze 6.8.14--6.8.15 supply the underlying finite-image exactness.

proof.text: Cover Y₀ by affine opens. Finite base change makes the source of each chart finite over an affine scheme and hence affine, so the separated-scheme finite-adic direct-image theorem applies to the geometric chart. Its rational adjunction identifies the exact heart direct image as the right adjoint to the specified heart inverse image; the normalized counit fixes this identification.

Extend the chart heart adjunction to ind-categories. Compute Hom from a representable into a filtered presentation using the heart adjunction. Every ind-object is a filtered colimit of representables, so the ind extension of heart direct image is right adjoint to ind inverse image. Exactness of the heart functor and exact filtered colimits make this extension exact. On overlaps the specified adjunctions identify these comparisons by uniqueness; the conservative open-cover criterion detects the resulting global exactness.

proof_origin.place: Underlying ordinary finite image in clause (1); the equivariant mate lift is proved separately.

lean.statement:
theorem sfFiniteIndHeartAdjunction
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    {X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [IsFinite f₀.left] :
    ∃ R : Ind (zlSmallHeart D l Ω hl X₀) ⥤ Ind (zlSmallHeart D l Ω hl Y₀),
      Nonempty (zlIndMap (zlSmallPull D l hl Ω f₀) ⊣ R) ∧
        PreservesFiniteColimits R
